lines.1: 「Well? Can you hear what they're talking about?」
lines.2: 「Not clearly from this far away... I did catch that some sedative from a woman named Laura works really well. That's the only part I heard.」
lines.3: 「I guess third-years even know foreigners, huh?」
lines.6: 「Whatever. Sounds like another lecture, so I don't need to hear any more.」
lines.7: 「Oh. Does that mean your little brother Takuma goes to this school too?」
lines.8: 「Takuma is at a school in Hokkaido. You remember how he loved soccer? He was delighted to earn a recommendation to a prestigious school.」
lines.10: I knew nothing about how my relatives were doing.
lines.11: No wonder I had not recognized her face.
lines.13: 「Hm. Class is beginning. We will speak again.」
